cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(prometheus_histogram_st LANGUAGES CXX)
option(HISTOGRAM_ST_SANITIZERS "Enable address/undefined/leak checks" OFF)
option(HISTOGRAM_ST_TSAN "Enable race checks (separate build)" OFF)
if(HISTOGRAM_ST_SANITIZERS AND HISTOGRAM_ST_TSAN)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "AddressSanitizer and ThreadSanitizer require separate builds")
endif()
add_library(histogram_st STATIC src/histogram_st.cpp)
target_include_directories(histogram_st PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(histogram_st PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(histogram_st PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow)
if(HISTOGRAM_ST_SANITIZERS)
  target_compile_options(histogram_st PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(histogram_st PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
if(HISTOGRAM_ST_TSAN)
  target_compile_options(histogram_st PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(histogram_st PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread)
endif()
add_executable(histogram_st_cli src/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(histogram_st_cli PRIVATE histogram_st)
include(CTest)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(histogram_st_preflight tests/preflight.cpp)
target_link_libraries(histogram_st_preflight PRIVATE histogram_st Threads::Threads)
add_test(NAME histogram_st_preflight COMMAND histogram_st_preflight)
add_executable(histogram_st_public_api tests/public_api.cpp)
target_link_libraries(histogram_st_public_api PRIVATE histogram_st)
add_test(NAME histogram_st_public_api COMMAND histogram_st_public_api ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/public_api_oracle.txt)
add_executable(histogram_st_performance tests/performance.cpp)
target_link_libraries(histogram_st_performance PRIVATE histogram_st)
